verdict.rationale: Automation versioning is a fair question for a cloud file-storage product, which could ship rules or automated workflows, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no OneDrive automation feature, let alone a way to version, review, or roll back one. File version history (onedrive-docs-23) and Graph API versioning policy are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
